I've been disappointed by similar products before, so quality really matters to me.

I hear you, and that makes complete sense. When you’ve been let down before, it’s hard to trust the next purchase, especially with something living like a plant.

A few things about Heirloom that might help put you at ease:

All of our roses are premium, own-root roses grown in Oregon in 1-gallon containers with soil (we don’t sell bare root). That means they’re grown on their own roots, which generally makes them longer-lived and more resilient over time.
We grow our plants ourselves rather than buying from third-party nurseries, so we control the quality from start to finish.
Every rose is covered by a one-year guarantee, and our garden advisors are available to help you troubleshoot planting, care, and any concerns.
We defoliate roses before shipping so they travel safely; they may not look glamorous right out of the box, but they’re grown to establish well and perform in the garden.
